تهتلكن (form VIII)
# تَهْتَلِكْنَ (tahtalikna) /tah.ta.lik.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# تُهْتَلَكْنَ (tuhtalakna) /tuh.ta.lak.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
